steps.name: Epilogue ~ The box opens and
steps.objective:
1. Check out the story of [Irrfan] and [▒▒▒] in 「Elysia」. 
2.  Check out the story of the group who visited the “Orcarium Secluded Place.”

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Hecate, are you here?

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Yeah.
(Hecate raises her head and gazes into the distance.)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: You can see the garden clearly from here too. Well done, Irrfan.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: As you said, we have reopened the garden gate.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: The process of opening the door would not have been easy. Your body may not be able to handle it... .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Seeing that it's okay makes me wonder if I should have given it a more difficult task.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Even if you ask me to do something else, I will gladly do it.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Irfan.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Yes, Hecate.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: At this point you should be asking me. Why am I doing this... .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: How dare I question the intention of what God does? I am your person, just doing what you ask me to do.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Thank you, Irfan. As expected, you are different from that child.
(Hecate looks satisfied with Irfan’s answer.)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Phew… .

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Daphne probably already knows. First, I allowed you to open the garden, and you opened the garden according to my will.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: … The beast called Pandora was so clever that she was deceived by the cunning Daphne.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Well, even I have no idea what’s going on, so it’s no wonder that the beast was deceived… .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Hecate, if Daphne offends you, I will punish her... .

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: No, you can just stay in Elysia and spend time like always.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Okay. I made a mistake.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: It's okay. Because now is just not the time yet.
(Hecate pats Irfan on the shoulder with empty eyes. Then turns her back and slowly walks somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Phew, if you wait, the moon will wax and wane on its own… .

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Manager, what on earth is the manager?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Huh? Calone, are you talking about me?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Who else is here other than the leader?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Calone, why are you doing this when you know it? I am Parmilla, leader of the Oscuras mercenaries.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I don't want to hear that answer.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I know that looking around Freyos with the leader is not a simple task.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: It's sweet today, it's a very sweet pumpkin. Calone… .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Sorry, Calone. I didn't treat you like a fool.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Don't act like you can't help it... . Then I feel even more sorry... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I needed some assurance.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: So what about now? Confidence in me... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I am confident enough. Because Calone has already become my favorite person.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Don't misunderstand. Because it means you’re one of my favorite people.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Okay. I'm used to it now, so there's no need to misunderstand it.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Wow, that's boring. Anyway, something happened to me. Ever since you became a member of our team because of your work at the Magic Agency lab... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I need to save you too, but because of what happened in the past, I also need to save my boss.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Boss… ?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: When I was adopted by a bad noble family and then given away, there was a day when I almost died. This is the mercenary leader who saved me.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I have never heard of such a person.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Because he is the person who disappeared from everyone's memories... . Really. It's so unfair that I'm the only one who remembers... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: The boss is like a benefactor to me. He saved me from a situation where I was about to die when I was abandoned... . Ah, don’t you feel more affectionate toward the boss than the leader?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Anyway, the boss disappeared at some point. He said he was going to check on something related to the Ministry of Magic, but he never came back.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Eh… , What is that ambiguous response… ? Is there anything else you want to know?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Is there anything else you need to know other than investigating the Ministry of Magic? This also explains why I came here, where the Magic Agency camp is located... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: When you went to Magic Academy Zerenis, you were embarrassed when you saw that I was friends with Shiina. Aren’t you curious about that?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I don't think that's a story I should be involved in... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: That's too much, Calone. I thought you might be a little more curious. Shiina seems to think it's her fault that I was let go... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Actually, the reason I broke up my relationship was because I saw things that other people couldn't easily see and felt things that they couldn't easily feel... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Finding a kitten who was a witch... .

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Witch? What does that mean? You found a witch?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Wait, Calone. There's a demon behind you... . be careful!
(Calone, startled, pulls out a dagger from his pocket and throws it at the being behind him.)
Aaaaa!! Please save me!
(Luckily or not, Calone's dagger passes by the demon that Parmilla was talking about.)
I should have received permission for this interview, but I’m sorry! Wow, I came this far just out of a sense of duty to find the scoop, and I don’t want to die!!

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … parrot?
Please save me! Just think of it as a talking parrot! I follow your words well. W, who else is here besides the leader!!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Even though you're a demon, you know how to hide, right? Now, Mr. Parrot. If you introduce yourself, I'll save you.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … heartbreak?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: I'm Daniel, a reporter who went out of Rosengarten looking for a scoop and became a freelancer because he had nowhere to go.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Are you saving me?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Parrot reporter Daniel.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Yes! Please speak up!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Have you ever written an article related to witches?
(Daniel’s eyes sparkle as he asks Parmilla.)

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: There is!

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: This is very exciting news that witches are killing witches and gathering witches!!

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: And it is said that Aaron, the chairman of the Sylvaria Empire Council, has joined hands with a witch!!
